RWA.note: The notice concerns the Capital Market Authority, not the central bank.
No consumer-protection rule or complaints body is stated.

facts.fact: The Capital Market Authority invited the public to read the draft regulation governing intermediary service platform operators on its website and send comments by email by 24 February 2026.

RWA.note: No government payment to people is stated.
No account-ownership survey figure is stated.

facts.fact: The Capital Market Authority, a regulator, put its draft regulation on intermediary service platform operators (fintech) out for written comment from fintech experts, lawyers, bankers, the payment industry and investors, with a physical consultation meeting to follow.

RWA.note: No mobile money or retail payment service is described.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
A sandbox exit regulation for fintechs is not a startup act, label or fund.
